confirmedIssues.title: Typed JSON editor and metrics disagree with string-valued mounted API
confirmedIssues.mechanism: JSON.parse produces true/false/number/object/array/null; the hook JSON.stringify sends that value directly. Go FlagSetRequest.Value is string, so non-null non-string JSON is a decoder error and the explicit 400 path runs. JSON null leaves the zero-value string empty and Set receives an empty string, not a stored JSON null. List/Get likewise serialize strings, so literal stored "true" is a string bucket and the editor seeds it as a quoted string.
confirmedIssues.safeRepro: Source trace only: a synthetic qa.boolean value input true produces body {"value":true,"reason":"QA explanation"}, incompatible with the server's string field. null produces a zero-value empty server string. A synthetic list entry with value "true" classifies as string. No PUT or flag creation executed.
confirmedIssues.reproExecution: NOTRUN — no mutation authority; deterministic source incompatibility, not a captured response.
confirmedIssues.need: One explicitly owned end-to-end value-contract fix: reconcile actual server storage/handler, TS response/request types, editor, metrics and documentation without inventing typed backend support or mutating flags. Add covering contract cases under a separate source/test claim.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: The handler can return 200 with Deleted=false (omitted by omitempty) when no flag existed, and returns audit_id=0 when audit is absent/fails. Both onSuccess callbacks discard _res; Delete always says deleted, and page/confirmation copy promises logging regardless of audit outcome.
confirmedIssues.safeRepro: Source trace only: delete an already-removed synthetic key => server Deleted=false => unconditional deleted toast. Successful store write with unavailable audit => audit_id=0 => overlay closes while the UI still promises the change was logged. No deletion, outage injection or auth action executed.
